citations.short: Authority lacking to review records, investigate errors
citations.long: The quality control unit lacks authority to fully investigate errors that have occurred.

citations.short: Written records kept in individual logs
citations.long: Written records of major equipment cleaning, maintenance, and use are not included in individual equipment logs.
The batch production and control records are deficient in that they do not include the identity of major equipment used.

citations.short: Sampling and testing plans not followed
citations.long: Written procedures for sampling and testing plans are not followed for each drug product.

citations.short: Procedures to be written and followed
citations.long: Procedures describing the handling of all written and oral complaints regarding a drug product are not established and written.
